user_instruction: Alright, turn the charter into a long-term goal and begin the project.
objective: Build and maintain a reproducible, ArcGIS-ready geospatial evidence package for the 26 August 2026 Nepal debris avalanche and flash flood that identifies credible before/after satellite observations, maps observable change in EPSG:32645, separates observation from interpretation and attribution, preserves source identity and uncertainty, and produces reviewable ArcGIS maps and exportable deliverables without obscuring failed or inconclusive evidence.
completion_rule: Complete only when the reproducible ArcGIS evidence package, reviewed change evidence, exportable deliverables, validation, and final release boundary are all satisfied.
